item.cinema.speaker_alignment_tool.toolt: Right-click a speaker to advance its acoustic aim by 10 degrees; sneak-right-click to rewind.
item.cinema.cable.tooltip: Pairing tool: right-click a projector then a screen, a receiver then a projector, or a receiver then a speaker. Sneak-right-click to clear that device's links.
item.cinema.remote_controller.tooltip: Sneak + right-click a projector or AV receiver to bind; right-click to open it remotely. Sneak + right-click air to unbind.
